Description / Calculation: The evaluation dataset shared by all paired models (PlantDoc test set).
The ordered model pair; all reported differences are computed as Model A minus Model B.
The performance metric evaluated independently for each seed: Accuracy or Macro-F1.
The number of matched random seeds used by each paired test: N = 10 (seeds 42–51).
The within-seed difference d_s = m_s^(A) - m_s^(B); a positive value favors Model A.
The unadjusted two-sided paired Student's t-test p-value for H0: E[d_s] = 0.
The unadjusted two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p-value applied to the paired differences d_s.
The Holm–Bonferroni-adjusted p_t across all six primary tests (3 model pairs × 2 metrics); controls the family-wise error rate.
The Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted p_t across all six primary tests (3 model pairs × 2 metrics); controls the false discovery rate.
The decision threshold is \alpha = 0.05; an adjusted p-value below 0.05 is considered statistically significant.
